plans.description: default search with an agent plan's sub-queries and weights where present

discovery.freshness_observation: sources rehashed for this call; external files stat-checked and rehashed on change
discovery.recheck_freshness: Sources were rehashed for the unscored warm-up query only; engine.recheck_freshness was then set to False for every scored query.

evidence: Development fixture: regression evidence only, not held-out evidence.

leakage.meaning: Expected stems or ids inside a query would reward exact string matching; exact-control queries that consist of the id are listed, not counted.

measurement.cross_family: Fraction of assessed positive queries whose first relevant hit lies outside the families implied by the query group.
measurement.graph_writes: None; the saved scientific graph and index are read only.
measurement.mrr_at_k: Mean reciprocal first relevant rank; zero for misses and errors.
measurement.negative_controls: Passed (empty): no primary hit. Passed (below median): top score below the median top score of positive queries in the same configuration.
measurement.recall_at_k: Fraction of positive queries with a listed relevant hit in the top k.
measurement.scores: Retrieval relevance only; never proof, support or scientific status.
measurement.source_diversity: Mean distinct source families among the top-k primary hits.

timings.note: Each scored query ran once per repeat in a reused process after one warm-up; medians over queries are reported per configuration. tracemalloc was off; peak memory comes from the process counters.
